A '''planet''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Marked">{{Tales|24|Marked}}</ref> far from the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="OSVC">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 21|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 21]]</ref> It hosted a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] ring, in which fighters competed to the [[Death/Legends|death]], with the winner collecting [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Spectators [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] over the outcome. The [[Drovian]] [[Silus (Drovian)|Silus]] killed several challengers, including the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Tabor (Aleena)|Tabor]] and [[Tabor's brother|his brother]], before he was in turn defeated by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Marked" />
